body:
> Meta · Alphalete · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A screenshot filing area for Alphalete created Oct 8 2026, with four subfolders: `Screenshot from GSC`, `Screenshot from Search Atlast` (spelled that way on disk), `Screenshot from Website` and `Screenshot from other`. As of this vault build (Oct 22 2026) all four subfolders are **empty**.

# Where Alphalete screenshots actually are
- `Alphalete Trenchless Pipelining\performance-evidence-2026-10-13\`: 15 report screenshots (GSC, Search Atlas, GA4, Keystone). See [Alphalete - Performance Evidence 2026-10-13](lib:brain-alphalete-performance-evidence-2026-10-13).
- `seo-audit-2026-09-11\source-data\ga4-exports\`: page images of the GA4 exports used in the Sep 11 audit.
- Three unnamed PNGs in the Alphalete project root (`(15724).png`, `(15726).png`, `(15727).png`, Aug 13), image files only.
